name: Takigawa Yumi
source:
"You're the only one I have, Akane."

The president of the Takigawa Corporation. Forced from childhood to behave as a man, she clings to Akane as the only person who wants her to be a woman.

[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/hanachirasu.html]JAST USA[/url]]
